mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the FEDFUNDS series.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high CPI index regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), a monthly increase in CPI above 0.2% signals persistent inflation and potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL > 230 and CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units indicates weakening residential demand, which typically precedes broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when HOUST falls below 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low employment growth (PAYEMS) and high unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 0.1% and UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth economic regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%), a decline in quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% signals recessionary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when GDPC1 annualized growth is below 1.5% and quarterly growth declines.
